# Catch UI persistence regressions before release

## What & Why
The current regression suite directly covers storage validation and round trips, but not the rendered import feedback or the actual add/edit/delete interactions after a browser reload. Browser-level coverage would protect the user-visible recovery flows.

## Done looks like
- A browser test imports malformed JSON and confirms the error is visible without changing the draft.
- A browser test confirms a valid export/import retains every profile field.
- Answer and application add/edit/delete flows are reloaded and verified through the UI.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/lib/storage.test.ts
- artifacts/escape-hatch/package.json
